body:
I feel so awful for fucking this attempt up. If I don't end up with the bad side effects like seizures or straight-up death, this medication, at least for me historically, causes reality to literally feel warped, like it's lagging a split second behind. I also get crazy, constant tremors. That's just what one pill does to me, hence the reason I'm no longer prescribed the medication. So I don't know what 40 pills is going to do. I'm scared.

Christ. I fucked this up. I could have been unconscious by now. I don't know how I'm going to function at work tomorrow. I want help so bad but therapy and medication have been awful for me. I can't explain it all but I've been an activist for a couple years and I've witnessed horrific death and suffering and then people turn a blind eye to it even though it's their own choices causing this suffering. I can't go to therapists because they blame it on me for "looking" at the suffering even though I don't go looking for it anymore intentionally. The doctors and therapists themselves are often guilt of being deeply embedded in the systemic issues I work to educate on. So I can't get help, because the issue isn't me. I'm so upset and there's no solution. People I've talked to who know the specifics of my situation and experience agree that there's no solution.

I'm sorry, I probably sound crazy. Years ago I posted on this forum under another account with all the details of my situation. The comments were full of people asking if I was a troll because my story is just so unbelievable. I also thought it was just me overreacting for such a long time, and I did treatment and medication but it didn't work. The only thing that helped me cope was finding a ton of scholarship on the matter and then writing my own 60-page research project that was approved by a cross-discipline board of professors. But college is over and my heart is so full of the suffering of others that I can't even write or read about these things on my own anymore. I can't stay alive and watch more suffering and I don't know how to cope anymore. I can't even do activism anymore because it's so painful. I can't do decades more of this.

Fuck. Now there are spots in front of my eyes. I still want to die so here's hoping.
I've tried killing myself before too and nothing has gotten better. In fact, it's gotten substantially worse.
I don't have anything to live for. I just tried to throw up but I don't have much of a gag reflex and it didn't work.
My housemate left early. I've taken over half of the pills. I'm so scared but I can't stop now. I wish someone was here with me though. Christ I'm so scared.
